text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Machine Learning Intern position at Bluepeak AI. As a current student pursuing a Bachelor of Commerce with a minor in Statistics at Coastal University, I am eager to apply my data analysis skills and programming background to the innovative projects at Bluepeak AI.

Throughout my academic and practical experiences, I have developed a solid foundation in data handling and analytical tools. During my time as an Operations Analyst Intern at Tidepool Logistics, I utilized SQL to identify delayed shipments, wrote reports used weekly by the operations team, and built dashboards in Power BI. Additionally, I cleaned shipment data in Excel and presented my findings to a team in PowerPoint. 

Beyond my internship, I have applied my technical skills to independent projects. Notably, I analysed two years of college canteen sales using Python, specifically leveraging pandas and matplotlib, which allowed me to suggest menu changes that successfully cut waste by fifteen percent. Furthermore, I built a Google Analytics 4 and Looker Studio dashboard for a student club's website and earned the Google Data Analytics Certificate in 2025. 

While my resume highlights my proficiency in Python using pandas alongside SQL and data visualization tools, I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to further develop my expertise in machine learning frameworks, natural language processing, and language model fine-tuning as part of your team. I am keen to bring my analytical mindset, dedication, and eagerness to learn to Bluepeak AI.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your needs for this internship.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
